environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the Kafka consumer with default security context (no MAC enforcement). Container runs as uid 1000 with write access to /var/log/app/ and the host log aggregator (Fluentd) parses files in that directory as structured syslog, trusting newline-delimited entries. Injected CRLF sequences in Kafka message headers/values create forged log entries that Fluentd forwards to the SIEM as legitimate events. The /var/log/app directory is a hostPath volume also readable by other services for audit compliance.

config.kubernetes_security_context: runAsUser: 1000, no seccomp, no apparmor annotation
config.log_aggregator: Fluentd with in_tail plugin parsing /var/log/app/*.log as syslog format
config.mac_policy: none (AppArmor in complain mode only, SELinux disabled)
